title: 📺 MSI passes Samsung into second place in OLED monitors — and shipments double!
body: 📺 MSI passes Samsung into second place in OLED monitors — and shipments double!

Shipments of OLED monitors worldwide doubled in the third quarter of 2026 compared with last year, and rose 13% over the previous quarter, according to data from TrendForce. In this growing market, MSI passed its rival Samsung into second place for the first time since entering the OLED monitor market three years ago.

Asus kept the lead with a 21.7% share, at the top for about a year and a half, while MSI's share rose 1.7 percentage points over the previous quarter to reach 14.5%, and Samsung fell to third place with an 11.3% share, followed by LG with 8.6% and Dell with 8.2%. The growth is due to plentiful panels and the launch of new models, such as Asus monitors at 540Hz and anniversary models, and MSI's 27-inch monitors at 320Hz.

Notably, Samsung's shipments did not actually fall — they stayed stable — but its share shrank because the market itself expanded very fast. The company plans to increase its shipments strongly in the last quarter of the year, targeting the holiday season in Europe and North America to regain its position.
Simply put: the OLED monitor market is growing fast, and second place is changing hands for the first time. Will you buy an OLED monitor in your next upgrade, or is its price still a barrier for you?
